reviewedBy: Dr. K. M. Rahman (Poultry Disease Specialist, DVM, MS)
disclaimer: Vaccine schedules should follow regional disease prevalence and cold-chain integrity guidelines. Consult your local veterinary officer.

stages.name: Brooding
tips: Pre-warm the brooder room 24 hours prior to chick placement.
Provide glucose/electrolytes in drinking water for the first 4-6 hours to combat transport stress.
Check chick crop fill at 8 and 24 hours after arrival; 95%+ of chicks should have soft, full crops.
Maintain 23 hours of bright light (30-40 lux) for the first 3 days to stimulate feeding.

milestones.title: Chicks Arrival & Hatchery Health Audit
milestones.instructions: Inspect chick uniformity, unhealed navels, and red hocks. Record initial arrival count and weigh 5% of chicks.

milestones.title: Newcastle (ND Clone 30 / LaSota) + IB Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop of combined ND+IB vaccine into one eye per chick. Ensure chick blinks and absorbs the drop before release.

milestones.title: Day 7 Flock Weight Benchmark Check
milestones.instructions: Weigh 50 randomly sampled chicks across shed quadrants. Target average weight is 180-200g (4-4.5x initial chick weight).

stages.name: Starter
tips: Gradually decrease brooder temperature by 0.5°C per day.
Expand brooding rings to give chicks 50% more floor space.
Ensure drinker height is level with the chicks' backs as they grow.
Inspect litter daily under drinkers for wet caking.

milestones.title: Infectious Bursal Disease (Gumboro / IBD Intermediate) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop in eye or via skimmed-milk stabilized drinking water. Protect vaccines from chlorine and sunlight.

milestones.title: Day 14 Weight & Feed Transition Audit
milestones.instructions: Weigh representative sample of birds (target: 450-500g). Prepare gradual transition to grower feed over 3 days.

stages.name: Grower
tips: Transition feed ratio: 75% starter/25% grower on day 15, 50/50 on day 16, 25/75 on day 17, 100% grower day 18.
Monitor for bloody droppings or ruffled feathers (early coccidiosis indicators).
Increase cross-ventilation to remove ammonia and heat buildup.
Implement 4 hours of darkness per night to promote bone development and lower sudden death risk.

milestones.title: Gumboro (IBD Intermediate Plus) Booster
milestones.instructions: Withdraw water for 1.5-2 hours before administration. Add skimmed milk powder (2g/L) to neutralize water traces, then administer vaccine water within 2 hours.

milestones.title: Newcastle Disease (ND LaSota) Drinking Water Booster
milestones.instructions: Administer live ND LaSota vaccine in cool, non-chlorinated drinking water. Ensure all birds drink within 2 hours.

milestones.title: Day 21 Flock Weighing & FCR Evaluation
milestones.instructions: Sample 50-100 birds. Target weight: 950-1050g. Calculate Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR = cumulative feed / total biomass).

stages.name: Finisher
tips: Check withdrawal periods on any coccidiostats or therapeutics prior to slaughter.
Run ventilation fans and tunnel cooling during hot afternoon periods.
Never disturb heavy birds during peak midday heat (12:00 - 15:00) to avoid heart failure.
Clean water lines daily to avoid bacterial slime.

milestones.title: Transition to Finisher Feed & Medicine Withdrawal Audit
milestones.instructions: Switch to finisher feed without prophylactic antibiotics to observe strict withdrawal rules before marketing.

milestones.title: Day 28 Weight & Pre-Harvest Review
milestones.instructions: Weigh sample birds (target: 1.5-1.7 kg). Project harvest dates and contact poultry traders.

milestones.title: Final Market Harvest Weighing & Batch Close
milestones.instructions: Perform pre-slaughter feed withdrawal 6-8 hours before harvest while keeping drinking water available. Record final flock weight and sold count.
